assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Produce one polished ORIGINAL Chinese technical textbook illustration for an embodied-AI foundations article. Landscape 1536x1024, light paper background #f6f6f5, cobalt blue #0837a5 and ink #171415, a very small amount of neutral gray. Flat precise technical line illustration with clear schematic robotic arms and grippers, readable Chinese sans-serif labels, generous spacing, large lettering (readable when image is shown at 780 pixels wide). No brand, watermark, title banner, gradients, pictorial human brains, decorative circuits or tiny paragraphs. Content accuracy and straightforward reading order matter.
Draw a closed loop explaining grasping a cup. Four clearly separated scenes in a clockwise 2x2 arrangement: top-left 感知, top-right 判断, bottom-right 行动, bottom-left 反馈. Clockwise arrows connect them, including a large return arrow from feedback to perception. Each scene depicts the SAME tabletop, a simple ceramic cup with handle, compact 6-axis robot arm with parallel jaw gripper, and external camera. 感知: camera sees cup and arm; label 读取图像与关节状态. 判断: cup position and grasp target shown as small cobalt pose axes and gripper goal outline; label 估计位置，选择动作. 行动: robot gripper approaches and grasps cup, with clear short movement arrow; label 执行抓取. 反馈: lifted cup is slightly tilted and slipping downward in the gripper; subtle slip arrow, camera/force feedback directs next adjustment; label 观察变化，调整动作. The feedback arrow must return to 感知. Illustrative conceptual physical scenes, not literal hardware measurements. Clear succinct accurate Chinese text only. Avoid implying that feedback is a completed final step rather than continuing the loop.
assets.inspection: Camera and state observation → grasp target judgement → execution → observed slip/force feedback → next observation. All four main Chinese stage labels and clockwise causal arrows visually checked.

Draw THREE stacked horizontal rows showing the same top-down tabletop scene, gripper starting at left and cup goal at right, with one obstacle between them. Align all three rows. Large labels at left: 路径, 轨迹, 控制. Row 1 路径: cobalt geometric curve goes from starting gripper around the obstacle to goal cup; short subtitle 经过哪里; no time labels. Row 2 轨迹: same curve and obstacle, three ghost gripper poses along route with accurate left-to-right time labels t0, t1, t2 and short subtitle 何时到达; tiny simple caption 时间仅作示意. Row 3 控制: zoom into one point of the same route showing a cobalt dashed target gripper pose (目标) and solid dark actual gripper pose (实际), a short arrow from actual toward target labelled 修正; a compact external sensor loop drawn below leads from actual robot state to 控制器 and command back to gripper; subtitle 根据反馈修正. Distinguish geometric route, timed motion and feedback execution through the pictures, not extra text. Arrow direction for correction must point actual toward target. Robot poses should be physically clear and no unnecessary arm anatomy.
assets.editPrompt: Edit this educational diagram. Preserve the TOP TWO ROWS exactly: 路径 and 轨迹 with their existing cup, obstacle, route and time samples. Repair ONLY the bottom 控制 row, maintaining the same paper/cobalt/ink art style and large Chinese text. Keep left title 控制 / 根据反馈修正. Replace the entire bottom-right diagram with a simple correct feedback controller loop: a small input label 目标位置 at x roughly 360 y730 points RIGHT into a box 控制器 centered around x650 y760; controller output arrow labelled 控制指令 points RIGHT into a simple top-down physical gripper at x1150 y760 labelled 实际夹爪. From that physical gripper, a separate clearly routed arrow loops DOWN then LEFT along the bottom y960, then UP into the controller, labelled 实际位置（反馈）. These three arrows MUST flow target→controller→gripper→controller. Do not point control commands at a cup. Above or next to the gripper show a small dashed cobalt target pose labelled 目标 and solid dark actual pose labelled 实际, with a short arrow from actual toward target labelled 修正. Keep content in bottom row y670 to1000 without clipping. No two-headed arrows, no ambiguous dangling arrows, no more extra nodes. Complete scientific schematic, clean and readable.
assets.inspection: Top-down geometric path, timed gripper samples, and feedback position control. Initial bottom arrows were ambiguous; corrected by targeted imagegen edit. Final arrows checked target position → controller → actual gripper → feedback to controller.

assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Produce one polished ORIGINAL Chinese technical textbook illustration for an embodied-AI foundations article. Landscape 1536x1024, light paper background #f6f6f5, cobalt blue #0837a5 and ink #171415, a very small amount of neutral gray. Flat precise technical line illustration with clear schematic robotic arms and grippers, readable Chinese sans-serif labels, generous spacing, large lettering (readable when image is shown at 780 pixels wide). No brand, watermark, title banner, gradients, pictorial human brains, decorative circuits or tiny paragraphs. Content accuracy and straightforward reading order matter.
Draw TWO stacked rows explaining learning versus execution, with headings 训练 and 运行 at the left. Top row training: human teleoperation demonstration of a robotic gripper lifting a cup, a small collection of camera frames plus action trace, arrow labelled 学习 to a simple neutral network symbol labelled 策略. Text labels only 示范数据 and 更新模型参数. Bottom row runtime: at left a camera and tiny joint-state chart labelled 当前观测, above a speech bubble 拿起杯子 labelled 任务; both arrows point into a copy of the same policy network symbol labelled 策略; arrow labelled 动作 goes to the robot arm/gripper lifting a cup at right. A large return arrow from the robot/environment under the row returns to 当前观测, labelled 新观测. A short note under the runtime policy states 使用已训练的参数. The two rows must be visibly distinct and connected only by a single vertical arrow from the learned policy above to the runtime policy below. Do NOT send feedback arrows into training, do NOT suggest weights update every control cycle. No brain icons. Make the diagram feel like a clear research textbook illustration, consistent cobalt/ink line art.
assets.inspection: Demonstration training updates parameters; runtime reuses trained policy and receives observations/task, produces actions, and feeds new observations back. Training/runtime arrows visually checked.
